segments.text: Dialed phone static, sniffle.
He died kneeling, not a weapon in his hand.
Traded cold steel for two rings to be a man.
Choose the freedom of a future over blood.
Killed by cowards while he knelt inside the mud.
He saw the code as a cradle, kept him fed and alive.
But angel in the forbidden district was the reason to strive.
He looked across the plaza, kept him fed and alive.
But angel in the forbidden district was the reason to strive.
He looked across the plaza where we first met the street, and saw her standing by the fountain, felt the pulse of a heartbeat.
He called me late, breath shaky, said the war was done tonight.
No more iron in my holster, KTD, I'm chasing light.
He had the jewelry, breath shaky, said the war was done tonight.
No more iron in my holster, KTD, I'm chasing light.
He had the jewelry in his palm, traded tools for the truth.
Throwing off the shadow that had haunted all his youth.
They
nodded with the hollow smiles that betrayers always wear.
Secret messages flying, unarmed and waiting there.
He walked into the circle, head high, totem straight.
He was exiting the darkness, stepping through the gate.
They nodded with the hollow smiles that betrayers always wear.
Secret messages flying, unarmed inside the mare.
He died kneeling, not a weapon in his hand.
Then the sirens hit the fade to be a black.
He was facing his angel, sun setting in the west, dropping to his knee, watching on his chest.
He never shot a man the back, never begged for a breath.
He died in the posture of a death.
Kneeling for his woman, that's where the cowards found him.
With the light of a new world finally wrapped around him.
He wanted clean hands, love instead of the hate.
A future they wouldn't let him live, a future too late.
They call themselves soldiers.
Cowards!
Killing a man with a ring.
He died kneeling, not a weapon in his hand.
Traded cold steel for two rings to be a man.
He died as a man with clean hands.
